description: What type of drug is this? Returns a drug's Established Pharmacologic Class as used in US FDA labelling (e.g. sertraline: Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitor; simvastatin: HMG-CoA Reductase Inhibitor), via the U.S. National Library of Medicine RxClass. Useful for patients, students and agents answering 'is it an SSRI / statin / opioid?'. Classes come from FDA product labels only, so older or non-US drugs may have none; it does not describe effects, safety or dosing. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, required, a generic or brand drug name (e.g. "sertraline")
